acceptance: After a workflow run that opens a new mirror PR, at most one auto/results-mirror PR is open.
No auto/results-mirror-* branch exists without an open PR, including branches of closed, unmerged PRs.
A test covers the close-older-PRs and delete-branches logic, including a mirror PR that was closed without merging.
context:
The workflow's draft-only design means stale PRs are visible but non-blocking; cleanup is a quality-of-life improvement, not a correctness requirement.

2026-10-09 tracker review: Moved from blocked to open. The production cadence is now known (89 mirror PRs since 2026-05-06), so the earlier hold until 2026-06-06 and the W0/W1 steps no longer apply, and the description was rewritten with current counts.
description:
`.github/workflows/sync-results-data-to-published.yml` opens a new draft PR named `auto/results-mirror-<develop-SHA8>` for every develop push that changes corpus paths, and nothing closes the older ones. As of 2026-10-09 there are 89 auto/results-mirror PRs: 46 merged, 36 closed and 7 open (#2746, #2747, #2770, #2777, #2780, #2782, #2837). 22 auto/results-mirror-* branches exist. The repository has delete_branch_on_merge enabled, so the leftover branches belong to closed, unmerged mirror PRs. The open PRs were last batch-closed by hand on 2026-10-06.

Scope: change the workflow so that
- when it opens a new mirror PR, it closes every older open mirror PR and deletes their branches;
- it deletes the branches of closed, unmerged mirror PRs.

Merging #2837 is owned by t3-drift-corpus-mismatch-20261009 and is not part of this item.

anti_patterns.dont: auto-close auto-mirror PRs that have been opened for less than the configured staleness window
anti_patterns.instead: gate cleanup on age + draft status + presence of a newer mirror PR for the same series.
anti_patterns.why: the maintainer may be in the middle of reviewing

preserves.behavior: Auto-mirror PRs labelled by a maintainer (e.g. `keep`, `needs-review`) must NOT be auto-closed.
Auto-mirror PRs that a maintainer has flipped from draft to ready-for-review must NOT be auto-closed.
